probes.note: a 502 is returned even with certificate verification disabled, so the gateway itself is not serving the API today; certificate renewal alone may not restore service

conclusion: The provisioned STATS_NZ_API_KEY authenticates against two live Stats NZ surfaces. (1) Aotearoa Data Explorer SDMX: unauthenticated data requests return HTTP 401, keyed requests return HTTP 200 CSV; the public catalogue lists 913 dataflows including 335 CEN23 tables. (2) Stats NZ Geographic Data Service (datafinder): the layer catalogue and per-layer metadata/CSV attachments are public and list the same electorate boundary families the archive holds, with CC BY 4.0; the WFS gateway accepts the key but did not expose a working per-layer GetFeature path in this probe, and geometry export needs a Koordinates account token. The legacy OData host api.stats.govt.nz is still unusable (expired certificate plus HTTP 502 even with TLS verification bypassed), so the §9 boundary re-capture remains blocked there; datafinder is the documented replacement platform and the practical route forward.
next_actions: Stop targeting api.stats.govt.nz/opendata/v1; Stats NZ now names datafinder.stats.govt.nz as its primary geospatial service.
Obtain a Koordinates account/API token for datafinder if GeoJSON/SHP export is required; the Stats NZ subscription key is not a Koordinates token.
Alternatively, capture the public per-layer CSV attachments plus the WFS capabilities as provenance, and resolve the per-layer GetFeature type name with Stats NZ support.
Keep STATS_NZ_API_KEY in the repo-local .env (gitignored) or a CI secret; never commit it.
ADE CEN23 tables are a separate rights-reviewed follow-up; the catalogue and one keyed slice are proven reproducible here.
